exposure: Number of visits to obstetrics and gynecology clinics
cohort: Women aged 20-44 years who had undergone vaginal or cesarean deliveries in 2009 in Korea
finding: Cesarean delivery may be more protective against CIS than vaginal delivery in women of childbearing age.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery may be more protective against cervical carcinoma in situ compared to vaginal delivery in women of childbearing age.
